art_note: The imagery relies on flat digital mockups rather than high-end campaign photography, reducing the luxury aesthetic.
desc_en: A refined silhouette defines this essential slim-fit piece. The design features a wide round neckline and long flared sleeves that introduce subtle movement and grace. Crafted from a soft, smooth fabric with gentle stretch, it offers a skin-friendly feel and a clean drape. Each piece is made to order to ensure exceptional quality. Available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada define esta pieza esencial de corte entallado. El diseño presenta un amplio cuello redondo y mangas largas acampanadas que aportan movimiento y fluidez. Confeccionado en un tejido suave y elástico, ofrece un tacto delicado sobre la piel y una caída impecable. Cada prenda se elabora bajo pedido para garantizar un acabado excepcional. Disponible con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 95% polyester, 5% spandex
· Slim-fit silhouette
· Wide round neckline
· Long flared sleeves
· Hand or machine wash at max 45ºC

· Made to order
· Worldwide shipping
